title: Uncertain State Space
text: Simulate uncertain system in Simulink, 1 input, 1 output, {Uncertain system variable (uss)} sets Uncertain system; {Uncertainty value (struct or [] to use nominal value)} sets the values to substitute for uncertain variables, {Initial states (nominal dynamics)} sets the initial state values of nominal system and {Initial states (uncertain dynamics)} sets the initial state values for uncertain dynamics. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Uncertain system variable (uss)
params.values: Uncertain system ss(ureal(’a’,-5),5,1,1) (default) | uss model | model or element that can be converted to uss

params.name: Uncertainty value (struct or [] to use nominal value)
params.values: Values to substitute for uncertain variables [] (default) | structure

params.name: Initial states (nominal dynamics)
params.values: Initial state values of nominal system [] (default) | vector

params.name: Initial states (uncertain dynamics)
params.values: Initial state values for uncertain dynamics [] | vector
